title: LymForest-25 random-forest model validated for survival prediction in DLBCL
summary: LymForest-25 is a random-forest survival model using 25 clinical, biochemical and gene expression variables. In a UK cohort of 481 R-CHOP-treated patients with 17 of 19 transcripts available, its gene expression signature predicted mortality at 6 months and 1, 2 and 5 years more precisely than cell-of-origin plus molecular high-grade classification, including in the unclassified group. Combining it with the IPI score gave the best predictions, mainly in patients under 70, and combination with LymphGen mutation classes showed a tendency to improve. Retrospective validation of a previously published model.
